title: An Eye on the Chapel
summary: Since Tam's story, the cleric has been frightened: someone painted a golden eye on the chapel door and left a note on the altar. Ask her what it says, then light the chapel with candles so the village feels safe there again.

goals.say: The note: 'AZAZEL IS MY LIGHT AND MY SALVATION.' It is signed in letters nobody can read.
goals.name: The Cleric

goals.say: With the chapel lit, the eye looks less like it is watching.

threats.name: The Cleric
threats.target_line: You've heard about the door, then. Come in. Quickly.
talk: Tam's stranger was here, wasn't he?
I think so. Read this. I can't say it out loud.
A demon's name. Old books say he was a god once. People don't paint his eye for fun.
Light the chapel. Eight candles. If they're watching, let them see we're not afraid.
